name: io.github.aborruso/ckan-mcp-server
description: MCP server for interacting with CKAN open data portals

environmentVariables.name: CKAN_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated CKAN hostnames to allow. Empty = any portal.

environmentVariables.name: CKAN_PRIVATE_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated host names that may be private (loopback, RFC 1918, IPv6 unique-local), e.g. a CKAN on localhost or an intranet. Empty = none.
